Hi Markus,

We’re starting the final procurement steps for our AI platform pilot and need Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report and related artifacts for our security review. Two quick asks to help us scope the submission:

1) What exact report files and control artifacts you can share for vendor review (full report, bridge letter, control matrix, log samples, etc.)?
2) What secure transfer options do you support (presigned S3 links, SFTP, secure Drive share, or vendor portal) and any typical retention/redaction rules?

Our security team would like an audit-period confirmation too — can you confirm the covered period in the Type II report (start/end dates)?

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-27T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report for procurement + delivery options

Hi Dana — thanks for the clear asks. High level response and an optional set of one-line replies you can reuse when sharing internally.

What we can share:
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) including auditor’s opinion and scope statement.
- Bridge letter (Word / PDF) outlining any timing or coverage clarifications if the report period doesn’t align with your expected window.
- Control matrix CSV with mapping to common SIG/CAIQ controls (sensitive fields redacted on request).
- Short log snippets and sample telemetry (text file) demonstrating retention and redaction practices.

Secure transfer options:
- Presigned S3 link (preferred for one-off report drops).
- SFTP (enterprise transfers, preferred for recurring artifacts).
- Managed secure Drive folder (for shared ongoing evidence).
- If you need an IP redaction pass we can redact sensitive configs before sharing.

Typical redaction/retention notes:
- We never share raw customer PII. Internal account identifiers can be redacted on request.
- Audit artifacts typically have minimal redaction except for proprietary operational scripts.

Audit period: the most recent Type II covers 2025-02-01 to 2026-01-31. If you need a different period or overlap note, we can provide a bridge letter describing coverage and any material changes since that window.

Quick one-line replies you can paste into internal threads or forms:
- "Redwood will provide a redacted PDF of their SOC 2 Type II (2025-02-01 to 2026-01-31), a bridge letter for coverage clarifications, and a control-matrix mapping to SIG/CAIQ."
- "Preferred delivery: presigned S3 link; we can do SFTP for recurring transfer or Drive for collaborative review."
- "We can perform targeted redaction of proprietary scripts on request; logs and telemetry will be sample excerpts only."

If that matches your needs I can prepare the presigned link and attach the bridge-letter draft for legal review. Would you prefer S3 presigned or SFTP? Also: do you need the auditor contact info?

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Security & Compliance 
Redwood Inference

+1 415 555 0124

Hi Markus — thanks, that’s helpful. A couple clarifications before you upload:

1) Delivery: presigned S3 link is preferred; we can accept a time-limited link that expires in 7 days.
2) Redaction: please remove any internal operational scripts and full hostnames; keep control mappings intact.
3) Audit period: your stated 2025-02-01 -> 2026-01-31 is acceptable, but our legal team requests a short bridge letter if there were material control changes since the end of the period.

Please also include: contact name and email for the auditor who issued the report, and a one-paragraph summary of any non-conformities or exceptions observed in the period (if any). If you prefer, include the auditor contact in the bridge letter itself.

We aim to attach the report to our vendor file and proceed to PO issuance by 2026-05-07.

Regards,
Eli Soto
Security Analyst, Gridlytics
audits@gridlytics.com
